compared with $113 for 2000–2009 (paraphrase by fetch tool)
Average Alberta Internal Load (AIL) increased 2.0 per cent to 10,316 MW in 2025

unsupported_wording: The closing sentence (energy-only market; pool price as hourly marginal price vs BC Hydro IRP long-run marginal cost; 'what a MWh is worth') is the author's interpretation, not checked against or printed in this source. 'lowest in eight years' is supported (p. ii, p. 7).
note: Read via WebFetch (model-extracted quotes; '$113 for 2000–2009' wording is the tool's paraphrase of p. 7). Marginal cost includes fuel, carbon and assumed $5/MWh O&M. Fetch date blank is internal, not in source.
